target: Teach another learner to reason about vision language alignment using a text-to-region grounding record. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.

competency.title: Teach vision language alignment — field data
competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about vision language alignment using a text-to-region grounding record. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: using language priors over image evidence

competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in a text-to-region grounding record.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include the data card, missingness check and permitted use.
Report region match and caption faithfulness with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: using language priors over image evidence.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of vision language alignment.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report region match and caption faithfulness against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for using language priors over image evidence; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
